feature_contract.goal: Improve game-Present host freshness performance and correct coherent IPC liveness to retain stereo through healthy and soft-suspended frames, but fail closed for stale host.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R21 Present liveness and its automated test/workflow only; no HUD, world stereo path, SkyGlow, input/FFB, R23 draw, DX11 or DXVK changes.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Prior source calls QueryPerformanceFrequency for every healthy host Present although it is boot invariant; schema header was read outside host heartbeat seqlock. Now the clock frequency is cached once per process and header/host fields share the same sequence generation. API-call reduction is source-derived, not a measured headset FPS gain.
trace_stages: Host writes IPC heartbeat/flags and schema under a seqlock; R21 receives game's Present hook.
R21 captures a single coherent header and heartbeat and calculates a bounded millisecond age with cached QPC frequency.
RuntimeEligibility fresh/soft/stale transitions gate R9 and downstream R23 per-eye stereo/host transport.
subcomponents: Move host IPC header into bounded seqlock reads, rejecting a torn/invalid header only from a stable sample.
Cache invariant QPC frequency while reading current time every Present; reject massive overflowed stale timestamps before arithmetic.
Register deterministic status/clock/mapping mutation verifier in exact-SHA Win32 workflow, preserving HMD separation.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Each valid Present uses a fresh QPC timestamp but only one cached boot frequency query for entire process.
Coherent header/host sample rejects torn/stale/overflow; fresh and shouldRender-disabled retain correct separate eligibility, transient read grace unchanged.
Negative verifier and same-SHA DX9Ex Active game/host/full-chain/package, Domain and Full Source Impact gates pass when applicable.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R21ComputeAgeMs calls QueryPerformanceFrequency for every successfully sampled Present and checks IPC schema without a sequence snapshot.
diagnosis.root_cause: Immutable QPC frequency sampled per game frame and IPC schema validated independently of its current heartbeat.
source_trace: Game R21 Present hook reads SharedState.
R21 age and schema drive fresh, soft-suspend or fail-closed RuntimeEligibility.
R9/R23 read gate decision before eye replay/host publishing.
alternatives_rejected: Caching QPC current time would silently allow a dead host to appear fresh.
Ignoring invalid schema even after a coherent read can resume from corrupted shared memory.
Unchecked signed delta multiplication could wrap stale host timestamps to a short age.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Same-generation schema/heartbeat, cached frequency, overflow rejection, fail-closed fallback.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Eight independent status input cases plus eleven destructive changes registered in CI.

ci_evidence.performance_evidence: Cached QPF once per process instead of per fresh Present; source-level API call count only, no headset p95/p99 measurement
